source_discrepancies_recorded: Syllabus row for Lecture 6 names career advice / reading papers / AI and healthcare and links two Fall 2024 decks; the recording is AI project strategy.
The recording calls the ratio "1 to 30"; positives to negatives is 1:29 (1:30 is positives to all windows).
The window geometry (3-s windows, ~10-s clips, 30 windows, 100 ms tolerance, one positive per clip) is not mutually consistent unless the hop is 100 ms; the chapter states the assumption.

The recording reports "50% on dev"; its metric is unspecified. Window accuracy of 50% is possible even at prevalence 1/30 and implies false activations on at least 0.5-p+ of all windows (0.467 at 1/30). The chapter retains the reported figure and states this limitation.
Page-selection share written 40% then replaced by 70%; the chapter uses 70%.
